open.finding: The two fractions reproduce as D_own/(D_own+D_face_separation), with longitudinal core rigidity neglected. They are fractions of conventional facings-only flexural rigidity, not fractions of collapse pressure. The roughly sevenfold linear/crimp ratios cannot be assigned to own-face bending alone.

open.impact: No all-mode crossing of 1 follows from the scalar product 1.00161658843; the owner correctly caps design credit, leaving the carried result unchanged.

open.finding: Two published numerical clamped-hemisphere collapse predictions lie above the conditional unity-crimp formula. They are not external-pressure experiments, do not isolate its assumptions, and do not calibrate a continuous gamma(Vc) curve or the 10 m Be/honeycomb sphere. Both cases are at Vc far above 2, so they do not test the moderate-Vc optimistic interpolation used in 009e. A conservative lower bound is not falsified merely by both values exceeding it.
open.proposed_next: Retain conditional numerical evidence for these cases, the handbook crimp rule, and the uncalibrated-curve tag separately.
